_description: Molicel INR21700-P42A. Curve digitized from lygte-info.dk's 0.2A (near-rest) discharge curve, 10% steps of measured capacity with 3.0V/cell as empty; values are approx +/-10mV. The 100% point is the cell's initial voltage under that light load, not the 4.2V charge voltage - packs above it just read 100%. Replaces floatwheel's task.c table, which read 30-80mV low between 80% and 40%. floatwheel pairs this cell with BOTH BATTERY_STRING=18 (GTV board) and BATTERY_STRING=20 (ADV board) - this chemistry alone doesn't tell you the series count, use --cell-count to match your actual pack.
